summary.text: Emily Thabes is the Democratic candidate for the Minnesota House of Representatives, District 2B, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A nonprofit executive director, she said in a Ballotpedia survey that stable state funding for child care would be her first priority in the House.

paragraphs.text: Thabes said in a Ballotpedia survey that she grew up in rural West Virginia, the daughter of a nurse practitioner, a teacher and a career veteran.
She holds a master's degree in library and information science and a master's degree in interdisciplinary leadership.
She said she has led teams at Hennepin County Library and Rasmussen University and supported the fraud team at Capital One Bank.
Thabes is executive director of the Beltrami County Historical Society in Bemidji and lives outside Bagley with her husband.

Thabes said that universal child care and keeping rural clinics and hospitals open are among her main goals, along with funding mental health and addiction treatment, paying direct-care workers and expanding broadband for telehealth.
